items.statement: The submission keeps neutral HL and singly azomethine-N-protonated HL distinct, with the stated charges and singlet multiplicities, and documents converged/stationary geometries before orbital extraction.
items.expected: Both states are explicitly identified and validated; no protonation, charge or multiplicity mix-up is present.

items.statement: The neutral HL calculation yields a HOMO–LUMO gap near the paper's reported neutral value.
items.expected: A numeric neutral HL gap in eV is reported with a reproducible orbital extraction description.

items.statement: The protonated HL calculation yields a lower HOMO–LUMO gap than neutral HL and is numerically comparable to the paper's protonated value.
items.expected: A numeric protonated gap and its comparison to neutral are reported.

items.statement: The submission compares frontier-orbital localization between states.
items.expected: It identifies neutral HOMO concentration on the fluorenone-side unit and a more electron-deficient/protonation-affected LUMO distribution after protonation, while labeling this as qualitative.
